in_sanskrit.name: धृष्टिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who shows or brings to view, the one who has the power to perceive, observe or notice

in_marathi.name: Dhristika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे View, Sight, Vision
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhristika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhristika is derived from the Sanskrit root dhri which means ‘to hold’ or ‘to see’. The name signifies one who has a clear vision, one who can discern truth and wisdom.
